correctness.rationale: Actual complete two-level S4 frame P=A_p⊕B_q with reflexive successor cones; bounded condition f[up x]=up f(x). Upper b always maps upper since singleton cone; if some lower maps lower then upper image must cover all B, hence permutation; if some lower maps to b upper then entire B maps to b. For q>=2 these modes cannot mix and latter forces constant f; for q=1 upper fixed and all lower may independently choose among p+1 targets. Thus q>=2 exactly q!p^p+q bounded maps, q1 exactly (p+1)^p. For a map whose frame image has q+k points, preimage Boolean-algebra image rank is 2^(q+k). Inclusion-exclusion U and V count exact k lower-image points, idempotence forces selected roots fixed and upper permutation identity, and eventual image equals set of cycle vertices. Specified-root forest count T(N,r)=r N^(N-r-1) derives from complete-graph Laplacian minor and yields all E,I,H formulas and support classifications, including exceptional k=0, q=1 and p=1. Independently exhausted cone equations and stable iterates for (p,q)=(1,2),(2,2),(3,2),(3,1),(2,1). In particular p3q2 E coefficient counts 2,6,36,12; I 2,3,6,1; H 2,18,24,12 at ranks 2,8,16,32; q1 p3 E ranks 2/4/8/16 counts 1/21/36/6, I 1/12/9/1, H 16/24/18/6, all match source. Universal proof is structural and forest enumeration, not a finite extrapolation.

Distinct multiplicities with identical support and rooted-forest refinement motivate future finite-modal endomorphism work.
